# Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering - Information and Library Science

> The Information and Library Science (ILS) program at Indiana University's Luddy School showcases faculty research, student achievements, and institutional news across Bloomington and Indianapolis campuses.

The ILS department is part of the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering at Indiana University. The program focuses on information science, library science, and related research areas, with faculty engaged in cutting-edge research and professional conference participation.

## Key Topics

- Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
